name: petlord
description: Create, animate, and run state-driven AI desktop pets — locally.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,studio -c yellow,green "npm run dev --workspace @petlord/generation-api" "npm run dev --workspace @petlord/studio"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n renderer,electron -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @petlord/desktop" "node scripts/start-desktop-dev.mjs"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/studio/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/generation-api/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run check:public && npm run check:design && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
